This looks like a product announcement. It’s actually a distribution masterclass.

Claude is now inside Excel two different ways. Anthropic’s own add-in (this announcement) AND through Microsoft Copilot, where Claude powers Agent Mode for spreadsheets. Microsoft pays AWS for that access despite AWS being a direct cloud competitor.

That happened because Microsoft’s internal testing showed Claude outperforms OpenAI on Excel financial functions. GitHub Copilot users now “primarily rely on Claude S
